info.title: JMW Capital Partners Trading API
info.description: US equities long-short momentum: research, model ledger and Alpaca PAPER trading automation.

schema.title: Response Imports Api Data Imports Get

post.description:
Re-import from the configured provider in the background (idempotent upserts).

Live providers fetch from 10 sessions before the latest stored session, so late
corrections are picked up.

put.description:
'approve' (default): month-end rebalance orders wait until the plan is approved on the Trading page.
'auto': they are sent automatically. Stop-loss covers are automatic in both modes.

until.title: Until
until.description: Last session to process (default: latest stored data)

inception_session.title: Inception Session
inception_session.description: Session at whose close cash is funded; default latest data session

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Ranking signal: composite (residual + sector-demeaned momentum + FIP) or plain 12-1

lookback_sessions.title: Lookback Sessions
lookback_sessions.description: Older momentum anchor: sessions before signal

skip_sessions.title: Skip Sessions
skip_sessions.description: Recent anchor: sessions before signal (skip month)

min_history_sessions.title: Min History Sessions
min_history_sessions.description: Valid bars required before the signal session

min_price.title: Min Price
min_price.description: Raw (unadjusted) close at the signal session must exceed this, USD

adv_window.title: Adv Window
adv_window.description: Sessions in the average dollar-volume window

min_adv_usd.title: Min Adv Usd
min_adv_usd.description: Minimum trailing average daily dollar volume, USD

slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps
slippage_bps.description: Assumed adverse slippage vs. the open, basis points

commission_per_order.title: Commission Per Order
commission_per_order.description: Assumed flat commission per fill, USD

commission_bps.title: Commission Bps
commission_bps.description: Assumed commission as bps of traded value

min_session_coverage.title: Min Session Coverage
min_session_coverage.description: Share of the point-in-time universe that must have a bar at the signal session; otherwise the rebalance is blocked

residual_window_months.title: Residual Window Months
residual_window_months.description: Rolling regression window for residual momentum

winsor_sigma.title: Winsor Sigma
winsor_sigma.description: Winsorize each component at mean ± this many std devs

long_pct.title: Long Pct
long_pct.description: Enter longs from the top fraction of eligible stocks

short_pct.title: Short Pct
short_pct.description: Enter shorts from the bottom fraction of eligible stocks

min_names_per_side.title: Min Names Per Side
min_names_per_side.description: Minimum names per book (filled by next ranks)

max_names_per_side.title: Max Names Per Side
max_names_per_side.description: Maximum names per book (best ranks kept)

buffer_exit_pct.title: Buffer Exit Pct
buffer_exit_pct.description: Buffer: a held long stays while in the top fraction, a held short while in the bottom fraction

min_side_gross.title: Min Side Gross
min_side_gross.description: Minimum gross per side, fraction of NAV

max_side_gross.title: Max Side Gross
max_side_gross.description: Maximum gross per side, fraction of NAV

max_total_gross.title: Max Total Gross
max_total_gross.description: Cap on long + short gross, fraction of NAV

max_long_weight.title: Max Long Weight
max_long_weight.description: Per-name cap on longs, fraction of NAV

max_short_weight.title: Max Short Weight
max_short_weight.description: Per-name cap on shorts, fraction of NAV

beta_neutral.title: Beta Neutral
beta_neutral.description: Size the short book so the overlay is beta-neutral (short gross = long gross x beta_L / beta_S); off = equal dollar gross per side under vol targeting

sizing.title: Sizing
sizing.description: vol_target: gross set by target_vol within the side limits; fixed: fixed_long_gross / fixed_short_gross (e.g. 130/30), no vol target

fixed_long_gross.title: Fixed Long Gross
fixed_long_gross.description: Long book gross when sizing = fixed, fraction of NAV

fixed_short_gross.title: Fixed Short Gross
fixed_short_gross.description: Short book gross when sizing = fixed and beta_neutral is off. With beta_neutral on, the short book is sized for overlay beta neutrality (long x beta_L / beta_S), capped at max_side_gross

core_beta.title: Core Beta
core_beta.description: SPY core: hold core_beta x NAV in the benchmark ETF under the long/short overlay. Rebalanced monthly; exempt from beta/sector neutrality; counts toward max_total_gross

margin_debit_spread.title: Margin Debit Spread
margin_debit_spread.description: ASSUMED margin-loan rate over RF (Ken French), per year, ACT/360. Only books whose longs exceed NAV + short proceeds (SPY core + overlay, 130/30) borrow

max_sector_net.title: Max Sector Net
max_sector_net.description: Max |long - short| weight per sector, fraction of NAV

short_min_price.title: Short Min Price
short_min_price.description: Raw close must exceed this to be shorted, USD

htb_adv_window.title: Htb Adv Window
htb_adv_window.description: Dollar-volume window for the hard-to-borrow screen

htb_exclude_pct.title: Htb Exclude Pct
htb_exclude_pct.description: Exclude the least liquid fraction of eligible stocks from the short book

borrow_fee_annual.title: Borrow Fee Annual
borrow_fee_annual.description: Assumed borrow cost, per year, charged per calendar day / 360

cash_interest.title: Cash Interest
cash_interest.description: Credit the risk-free rate (Ken French RF) on positive cash, per calendar day / 360. The alpha regression then uses excess returns (r - RF); otherwise raw returns.

short_stop_loss.title: Short Stop Loss
short_stop_loss.description: Cover a short when its close is this fraction above entry (fill next open)

crash_guard.title: Crash Guard
crash_guard.description: Scale down the short book in bear/high-vol markets

crash_short_scale.title: Crash Short Scale
crash_short_scale.description: Short-book multiplier when the crash guard is on

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Backtest start (ISO date); ignored by the paper ledger

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Backtest end (ISO date); ignored by the paper ledger

StrategyConfig.title: StrategyConfig
StrategyConfig.description:
All tunable inputs of the strategy.

Long the strongest / short the weakest decile by the selected momentum signal, with a rank
buffer, inverse-volatility weights with per-name caps, beta- and sector-neutral books scaled
to a volatility target within gross limits, a momentum-crash guard, a short price floor, a
hard-to-borrow liquidity screen, borrow fees and a short stop-loss.
Every backtest run and every paper-portfolio configuration version stores the full JSON.

side.title: Side
side.description: long | short | None in this live ranking

model_weight.title: Model Weight
model_weight.description: Signed target weight in this live ranking (negative = short)

plan_target_weight.title: Plan Target Weight
plan_target_weight.description: Target weight in the latest frozen paper plan
